authoring.allowed_input_boundary: Only frozen source corpus files, the exclusion-only list of prior positive owner paths, and the provided fixture schema were used.
authoring.tooling_scope: Source inventory and range reads, source hashing, serialization, and metadata-only bounds/declaration checks.
limits: The author uses the same model family as the coordinator.
A high-level environment memory summary was present in inherited context. No memory files, prior fixture text, or retrieval output were consulted.
The source_head value comes from the supplied exclusion-only metadata. The copied source corpus has no resolvable HEAD commit locally.
Queries were authored from inspected runtime implementations, so this is a fresh source-authored relevance set rather than a blinded user-query sample.
No claim is made that the negative capability judgments exhaust all possible behavior outside the inspected neighboring contracts.

case_evidence.query: Allow another repair attempt only after recorded checks actually fail
case_evidence.independently_authored_intent: Find the decision owner that permits a bounded retry after current observed verification receipts contain a normal failure.

owner_evidence.reason: The function validates the contract and audit, accepts only current or receipt_failed check evidence, and rejects an empty set of failed checks.

case_evidence.query: Build a short navigation map within a caller supplied byte budget
case_evidence.independently_authored_intent: Find the implementation that constructs the question-specific repository navigation shortlist while honoring its byte budget.

owner_evidence.reason: The owner adds at most three files and three definitions per file, charging each rendered line against input.budget_bytes before inclusion.

case_evidence.query: Check whether a selected Python test directory has conventional tests
case_evidence.independently_authored_intent: Find the runtime advisory scan that recognizes conventional Python test names inside the selected command scope.

owner_evidence.reason: The scanner recognizes test_*.py and *_test.py and reports presence from bounded directory traversal rather than treating arbitrary Python files as conventional directory tests.

supplemental_source_evidence.reason: The command planner selects a single pytest path or the current directory and rejects unsupported filters, establishing the selected discovery scope.

case_evidence.query: Record C sharp imported namespace paths from aliased using directives
case_evidence.independently_authored_intent: Find the C sharp extractor operation that reads the right hand namespace path from an aliased using directive.

owner_evidence.reason: The implementation strips using/static prefixes, selects the right hand side of an alias assignment, and emits an import pointing at that namespace path.

case_evidence.query: Capture Java declaration annotations using their unqualified names
case_evidence.independently_authored_intent: Find the extractor that records annotation names on Java declarations after stripping package qualification.

owner_evidence.reason: The function scans annotation and marker_annotation modifier children, retains the final dotted name segment, and returns the decorators representation.

case_evidence.query: Record aliased PHP imports inside grouped namespace declarations
case_evidence.independently_authored_intent: Find the PHP extractor responsible for grouped use imports and alias names.

owner_evidence.reason: The grouped-use parser splits the brace members and passes the namespace prefix into emit_use_item; that helper separates an alias and emits its resolved full import path.
The helper resolves each grouped member against the namespace prefix, separates its alias, and emits the alias name and full imported path.

case_evidence.query: Turn off transcript synchronization for one collected conversation source
case_evidence.independently_authored_intent: Find the operation that opts one previously registered transcript source out of later sync selections.

owner_evidence.reason: The entrypoint checks the source belongs to the exact project root, changes its sync_enabled state under the private-store mutation boundary, and retains observations and review history.

case_evidence.query: Recover pending project hook delivery markers after an interrupted update
case_evidence.independently_authored_intent: Find explicit recovery of durable pending native hook delivery admission markers for one project/client prefix.

owner_evidence.reason: The recovery function enumerates the bounded marker set, filters to the requested prefix, and removes regular files only with their observed stable identities.

case_evidence.query: Compare profile task outcomes using observations bound to one task revision
case_evidence.independently_authored_intent: Find the offline evaluation operation that compares supplied baseline/profile task outcomes bound to a common task revision.

owner_evidence.reason: The function requires a unique valid task revision and opposite profile conditions, validates trial observations, computes profile-minus-baseline means, and keeps causal effect unestablished.

case_evidence.query: Explain why project hook learning is not ready to run
case_evidence.independently_authored_intent: Find the read-only readiness report that distinguishes native configuration, capture, refinement, delivery, and mining boundaries.

owner_evidence.reason: This entrypoint inspects project/client state and constructs separate readiness observations. It does not install hooks or execute a worker merely because configuration exists.

supplemental_source_evidence.reason: The report previews native installation without writing, separates platform support from mining state, and marks worker outcomes and draft publication limits.

case_evidence.query: Install native client hooks while preserving unrelated existing hook commands
case_evidence.independently_authored_intent: Find the configuration merge operation that replaces owned native hook handlers while preserving unrelated user handlers.

owner_evidence.reason: It removes only command handlers whose command ends with the exact registration suffix, leaves remaining groups intact, and appends the generated handlers.

case_evidence.query: Renew a retired habit as a new candidate without copying evidence
case_evidence.independently_authored_intent: Find the lifecycle operation that renews a rejected or superseded learned habit as a fresh generation with no carried observation pin.

owner_evidence.reason: The method checks the reviewed parent revision and retired status, creates a candidate from its description fields, records the generation relationship, and deletes the parent's observation pin.

supplemental_source_evidence.reason: The method's explicit constraint is that renewal copies only the description and never support or a pin.

case_evidence.query: Withdraw one preference source while retaining its quotes and review history
case_evidence.independently_authored_intent: Find withdrawal of one collected preference observation while retaining immutable receipts and quotations.

owner_evidence.reason: The method binds dismissal to the inspected preference revision and candidate, inserts a dismissal record, removes acceptance, and appends a review event instead of deleting stored quotations.

case_evidence.query: Mark a learned habit observed only for the inspected review revision
case_evidence.independently_authored_intent: Find the review transaction that observes a learned habit only at its currently inspected definition and evidence revision.

owner_evidence.reason: The observed path requires the exact current review_revision, checks observation eligibility, and commits its observation pin, status, and review event atomically.

case_evidence.query: Render an audit comment after verifying repository and commit identity
case_evidence.independently_authored_intent: Find the publication-oriented audit rendering entrypoint that verifies the expected repository, baseline, and head before producing Markdown.

owner_evidence.reason: The command verifies a sealed envelope against expected repository and commit IDs with a clean-worktree requirement, rejects failed policy verification, and prints the trusted render.

case_evidence.query: Audit a spec using an index bound to current sources
case_evidence.independently_authored_intent: Find the CLI audit entrypoint that requires a populated source-bound index and rechecks snapshot currency after the audit.

owner_evidence.reason: The entrypoint opens an index through open_validated_index, runs the audit against that store, and calls ensure_source_snapshot_current after execution.

supplemental_source_evidence.reason: The called index-opening boundary checks schema, project root, population, and current source snapshot before allowing audit use.
